etsy.description:
A welcoming stim poster for a Fidget Friendly Zone, letting visitors know fidget tools, stimming, and movement are okay here.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang near a fidget bin, sensory corner, or classroom shelf to signal stimming and fidget tools are welcome.

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical, therapy, or educational advice. Thank you for supporting a small, neurodivergent-run shop!

competitorNotes: Stimming posters on Etsy are mostly humorous digital downloads or 'everybody stims' lists; 'Stimming welcome here' wording exists as framed prints.
Listings target SEN/autism-friendly classrooms, calm corners and therapy offices.
Most shared-project results (sensory room, calm corner, neurodiversity decor) are digital printables; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Amazon results are mostly fidget toys; one unframed 16x24 'Stim Chart' neurodiversity affirmation poster for classrooms or homes.
